x_multimeter.lore.uncommon: Has a dial with twenty settings, and everyone who borrows it just leaves it on the beeping one.

x_pocket_watch_chain.lore.epic: Got hooked on a coat rail at the station, and pulled a whole row of coats onto the platform.

x_stopwatch.lore.uncommon: Has a lap button that its owner forgets every race, so second place is always a guess.

i_hard_disc.lore.legendary: Was dropped down a flight of stairs, kept spinning, and saved a whole novel its owner had forgotten to back up.

i_mousetrap.lore.common: Gets set in the wrong place every time, so it catches slippers, socks and the dog's nose instead of mice.

mouse.lore.legendary: Has clicked a hundred million times and still glides across the mat as smoothly as the day it was unboxed.

x_electric_razor.lore.common: Leaves a little patch of stubble under the nose every morning, and nobody notices until lunchtime.

x_docking_station.lore.common: Has a nest of cables behind it so tangled that unplugging one turns off the desk lamp.

x_garage_remote.lore.legendary: Opened the garage just in time for a runaway pony to shelter from a hailstorm, and the pony still visits.

x_universal_remote.lore.common: Has fifty buttons, and the family only ever uses three of them.
